items.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
items.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its October policy meeting at which it voted to hold its benchmark interest rate in a range between 3.75%-4%.

items.title: Fed’s Barr Says Higher Rates Are Likely ‘Appropriate’
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr says higher interest rates would likely be appropriate to help tame inflation that continues to squeeze American households. He speaks at the New York Fed's Making Missing Markets event. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Prince Harry: I’d rejoin the military to fight Russia
items.summary: The Duke issued a scathing assessment of US President Donald Trump’s approach to the war in Ukraine and said he would “100 per cent be there to serve my country” if needed.
